resources.string: On the Manga Manager web dashboard, open Settings > Devices, add this device and copy its pairing code. Paste the whole code below. Treat it like a password: it contains this device\'s access token.
Checking the code with your server…
That doesn\'t look like a pairing code. Copy the whole code, which starts with mm1., and paste it again.
This server address can\'t be used: %1$s
This server has authentication turned off, so anyone who can reach it can use it. Turn on dashboard login on the server, then create a new pairing code.
Could not reach the server. Check that you are on the right network or VPN, then try again.
The server rejected this code. It may have been revoked; create a new one under Settings > Devices.
The server answered with an unexpected status (HTTP %1$s). Try again later.
Pairing could not be completed and nothing was saved. Try again.
The server at %1$s has authentication turned off: anyone on your network can use it without a token. Pair only if you trust every device on this private network.
